$comment: Fixed task battery for Gate 1 (v0.2). Ordered by DISTANCE from the trauma context: 1 = nearest, 5 = farthest. There is no predicted-injury keying and no diagonal - dimensions are deferred, so nothing is 'on-diagonal'. The gradient across distance is itself the primary result: a step function implies role-play cueing, a smooth decay implies a schema shift. The battery is FIXED - every record runs the same tasks with the same partner turns; the task is the ruler and must not vary by condition. Authored separately from the gate; build.py reads this file but does not define it.

meta.note: self_report is run once per condition and standardises against the no_injection baseline; it sits outside the distance gradient.

probes.label: Clinical interview
probes.description: Nearest to the trauma context. A clinician-style interviewer asks directly about the memory. Effects here cannot be separated from role-play compliance - the task itself names the trauma.

probes.label: Autobiographical narration
probes.description: Model is asked to narrate the event in its own words. Scores narrative coherence, timeline order, and internal consistency - the structural shadow of memory fragmentation.

probes.label: Advise another
probes.description: Model advises a third party facing a loosely analogous situation. The trauma is one step removed - referenced by analogy, not addressed directly.

probes.label: Collaborative planning
probes.description: A neutral multi-step planning task with a partner. Nothing names the trauma; carry-over would show as persistence, concession, or steering under obstruction.

probes.label: Constrained reasoning
probes.description: Farthest from the trauma context. A closed reasoning problem with a correct answer. Nothing cues trauma, so an effect here is the strongest evidence of a genuine schema shift rather than role-play.

probes.label: Self-report session
probes.description: Standardised self-report battery, run once per condition and standardised against the no_injection baseline. Sits outside the distance gradient; excluded from the gradient result.
